attractions.name: Loiben villages (Oberloiben & Unterloiben)
attractions.description: Villages in the heart of the Wachau vineyards with top wineries; ~15–20 min walk from Dürnstein through vineyards or by river path.
attractions._source_file: Switzerland/All Inclusive Guide - Switzerland and Austria(1).docx

attractions.name: Wachau Vineyard Visit & Tasting
attractions.description: Walk through Danube-facing vineyards with a vintner; tasting typically includes Grüner Veltliner, Riesling and local apricot schnapps. Wines and preserves available for purchase.
attractions._source_file: Switzerland/All Inclusive Guide - Switzerland and Austria(1).docx

attractions.name: Heuriger
attractions.description: Wine-grower's tavern serving the latest wines with home-cooked food, typically cold plates of cheeses, meats and breads.
attractions._source_file: Switzerland/All Inclusive Guide - Switzerland and Austria(1).docx

attractions.name: Wachau Danube Cycling Route
attractions.description: Mostly flat, beginner-friendly cycling route through terraced vineyards and riverside villages; bikes via Nextbike app or a local rental shop in Spitz

attractions.name: Melk Abbey
attractions.description: Grand baroque hilltop monastery overlooking the Danube

attractions.name: Dürnstein
attractions.description: Historic Danube village with medieval town, Stiftskirche Cloister Tower and castle ruins where Richard the Lionheart was imprisoned

attractions.name: Wachau Valley Cycling Route
attractions.description: Easy and scenic cycling route through terraced vineyards, riverside villages, and Wachau wine country. Mostly flat and beginner-friendly. Suggested stop at Weißenkirchen.

attractions.name: DDSG Blue Danube Cruise
attractions.description: Scenic cruise through Wachau Valley vineyards and riverside villages. Beautiful perspective of the Danube from the water. Board at DDSG Blue Danube dock near the Dürnstein river promenade.

hotels.name: Hotel-Restaurant Kirchenwirt
hotels.location: Heart of the Wachau wine region, surrounded by terraced vineyards; onsite parking
hotels._source_file: Switzerland/All Inclusive Guide - Switzerland and Austria(1).docx

local_dishes.description: Signature white wine of the Wachau region
local_dishes.where_to_try: Domäne Wachau, Weingut und Heuriger Maria & Manfred Hick

local_dishes.name: Riesling
local_dishes.description: World-class white wine produced on the steep terraced slopes of the Wachau

safety_tips.tip: Reconfirm exact DDSG Blue Danube cruise timings a few days before travel, as schedules may vary seasonally.

souvenirs.item: Austrian wines, apricot liqueur, pumpkin seed oil
